title: A human heartbeat
subtitle: One person's heart, from its MRI: the blood it pumps and the vortex inside
hook: A heart beats some three billion times in a lifetime. Predict one beat of one person's heart.

media.alt: A three-leaflet valve in an aortic root opens as blood jets through it and closes into a seal
media.caption: The lab today: a three-leaflet valve in an aortic root opens, jets and closes through a heartbeat, the blood and the leaflets computed together on the GPU. The heart that drives it is what this flag asks for.

note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
